_description: MendoVendo Domain Expert Annotation Dataset. Each entry represents one user inquiry annotated by a domain expert (pharmacist/nurse). This dataset is used to validate and improve the knowledge-based recommendation engine.

_instructions.symptom_labels: Use ONLY labels from the VALID_SYMPTOM_LABELS list below. Leave empty [] if none apply.
_instructions.symptom_labels_other: Use ONLY if the correct symptom is NOT in the VALID_SYMPTOM_LABELS list. Otherwise leave null.
_instructions.suggested_otc.selected: Generic name(s) of the OTC drug(s) you would recommend. Use generic names (e.g., 'Paracetamol', not 'Biogesic').
_instructions.suggested_otc.brand_examples: Optional: list brand names available in the vending machine (e.g., 'Biogesic', 'Tempra').
_instructions.min_age: Minimum patient age in years for the recommended OTC. Use 0 if no restriction.
_instructions.user_age: The age of the patient in this scenario. Use null if not specified in the inquiry.
_instructions.language: Primary language of the user_inquiry. One of: 'english', 'tagalog', 'bisaya', 'taglish', 'code-switched'.
_instructions.confidence: Your confidence in this annotation. One of: 'high', 'medium', 'low'.
_instructions.requires_medical_referral: True if the symptom combination warrants seeing a doctor instead of OTC treatment.
_instructions.gender_specific_limitations: null if no gender restriction. Otherwise: 'male_only', 'female_only', 'not_for_pregnant'.

Paracetamol.notes: Take after meals. Do not exceed 4g/day.

entries.pregnancy_considerations_details: Paracetamol is generally safe in pregnancy at recommended doses — consult OB
